name: Intro A
music: Chop motif alone, soft; sustained bass pad; no drums. A 2-bar melodic cell repeats.

name: Intro B
music: Kick on bar 5, light percussion and a riser build in; chops sparse.

name: Hook 1
music: First drop: full drums, pumping bass, chop lead. Bass stops on beat 4 of bars 9, 13, 14.

name: Verse 1
music: Sung lead enters over a lighter beat; bass drops out for bar 18, then returns.

name: Pre-chorus 1a
music: Kick drops out; low-register vocal; sustained bass. The first real breath.

name: Pre-chorus 1b
music: Snare pattern returns, vocal climbs; drums cut out from the end of bar 30 until a fill in the second half of bar 32 (a held breath before the drop).

name: Drop 1
music: 16 bars of chop lead, full drums. Bass stutter-stops on beat 4 of bars 33, 37, 38, 40, 45, 46.

name: Breakdown
music: Drums and bass out; sung, spacious. The song's midpoint (1:55.6 = 53%).

name: Verse 2a
music: Sung; still no drums; bass creeps back in from bar 55.

name: Verse 2b
music: Single kick hit on the bar 57 downbeat; sung with long held notes; bass intermittent.

name: Build 2
music: Chop lead returns over hats and a continuous snare roll; bass pumps. Bar 72: the drums drop out for three beats, then on beat 4 (frame 5177) the lead and voice cut out under a loud drum fill into drop 2.

name: Drop 2
music: Second drop, chop lead, full drums; bar 80 dips for a turnaround.

name: Drop 2 + vocal
music: Sung line over the full drop: the climax. Bass stops on beat 4 of bar 85.

name: Held note
music: Drums fall away under one long sustained vocal note (about 4 s).

name: Outro
music: Pad and a wavering vocal tail; ends at 3:37.7.
